answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 43 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in lotus, queued in tundra, and island publishes the wait time. A farm of 69 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4055 identities would post 574 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
